verdict.rationale: Metronome documents a dedicated /ingest endpoint (plus Segment) for usage events, high-volume ingestion of up to 110,000 events per second without pre-aggregation, and built-in idempotency for safely retrying requests. An event explorer for inspecting the pipeline and a usage-event design guide round out the developer story. Missing for 10: any evidence of backdating or late-arriving event support, and independent or hands-on corroboration of throughput and idempotency claims.
